name: nexus-font
title: Nexus UI Inter Font
description: Inter font setup used by Nexus UI components so installed components match the preview typography.

theme.--font-sans: 'Inter', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
theme.--font-mono: ui-monospace, 'Cascadia Code', 'Source Code Pro', Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, monospace
